   • For a range of candidate powers (e.g., 1–20), compute the adjacency matrix for each power using adjacency_ij = |cor(cori,j)|^power.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import dynamicTreeCut
import gseapy as gp
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load and align data
data_expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
data_expr.columns = data_expr.columns.str[:12]
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv',
                   usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode','pharmaceutical_therapy','age_at_diagnosis','pathologic_stage'])
clin = clin[clin['pharmaceutical_therapy'].isin(['YES','NO'])].dropna().set_index('bcr_patient_barcode')
samples = data_expr.columns.intersection(clin.index)
expr = data_expr[samples]
clin = clin.loc[samples]
print(f"Cohort: {len(samples)} samples ({clin['pharmaceutical_therapy'].value_counts().to_dict()})")

# Traits
treatment = (clin['pharmaceutical_therapy']=='YES').astype(int)
age = clin['age_at_diagnosis']
stage_dummies = pd.get_dummies(clin['pathologic_stage'], prefix='stage', drop_first=True)

# 2. Filter to top 5000 variable genes
top_genes = expr.var(axis=1).nlargest(5000).index
data = expr.loc[top_genes]
print("Filtered to top 5000 genes.")

# 3. Soft-threshold selection
corr = data.T.corr().values
powers = range(1,21)
fit_idx, mean_conn = [], []
for p in powers:
    adj = np.abs(corr)**p; k = adj.sum(1)-1
    mean_conn.append(k.mean())
    counts, bins = np.histogram(k, bins=10)
    mids = (bins[:-1]+bins[1:])/2; mask = (counts>0)&(mids>0)
    if mask.sum()<2:
        fit_idx.append(np.nan)
    else:
        x=np.log10(mids[mask]); y=np.log10(counts[mask])
        coef=np.polyfit(x,y,1); yhat=np.polyval(coef,x)
        fit_idx.append(1 - np.sum((y-yhat)**2)/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2))
# Plot fit and connectivity
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()
ax1.plot(powers, fit_idx, '-o', color='b'); ax1.axhline(0.85, color='b', linestyle='--')
ax1.set_xlabel('Power'); ax1.set_ylabel('Scale-free fit', color='b')
ax2 = ax1.twinx(); ax2.plot(powers, mean_conn, '-o', color='r'); ax2.set_ylabel('Mean connectivity', color='r')
plt.title('Scale-free fit & connectivity'); plt.show()
# Select power
valid = [(p,f) for p,f in zip(powers, fit_idx) if not np.isnan(f) and f>=0.85]
soft = valid[0][0] if valid else powers[np.nanargmax(fit_idx)]
print(f"Chosen soft power: {soft}")

# 4. Adjacency and TOM
adj = np.abs(corr)**soft
def tom_sim(adj_mat):
    n = adj_mat.shape[0]; ki = adj_mat.sum(1)
    tom = np.zeros_like(adj_mat)
    for i in range(n): tom[i] = (adj_mat[i]*adj_mat).sum(1) + adj_mat[i]
    ki = ki[:,None]; tom = tom/(np.minimum(ki,ki.T)+1-adj_mat)
    np.fill_diagonal(tom, 1); return tom
TOM = tom_sim(adj); dissTOM = 1 - TOM

# 5. Gene clustering & module detection
dist_cond = squareform(dissTOM, checks=False)
Z = linkage(dist_cond, method='average')
print("Detecting modules...")
ch = dynamicTreeCut.cutreeHybrid(link=Z, distM=dissTOM, minClusterSize=30)
labels = pd.Series(ch['labels'], index=top_genes)
print(f"Initial modules: {labels.nunique()}")

# 6. Merge modules by eigengene correlation
def calc_eigengenes(lbls):
    M = {}
    for mod in np.unique(lbls):
        genes = lbls.index[lbls==mod]
        mat = data.loc[genes].T
        pca = PCA(n_components=1); M[mod] = pd.Series(pca.fit_transform(mat).flatten(), index=mat.index)
    return pd.DataFrame(M)
ME = calc_eigengenes(labels)
cor_eig = ME.corr().abs(); merged = labels.copy(); new_lab=0; visited=set()
for m in cor_eig.columns:
    if m in visited: continue
    stack=[m]; comp=set()
    while stack:
        u=stack.pop()
        if u not in comp:
            comp.add(u)
            nbrs = cor_eig.index[cor_eig[u]>0.75].tolist(); stack += nbrs
    visited |= comp; new_lab += 1
    for old in comp: merged[labels==old] = new_lab
labels = merged
modules = {lbl: labels.index[labels==lbl].tolist() for lbl in labels.unique()}
print(f"Merged modules: {len(modules)}")

# 7. Final eigengenes
MEf = calc_eigengenes(labels)

# 8. Association testing (with dtype conversion)
results = []
for mod in MEf.columns:
    y = MEf[mod].astype(float)
    X = pd.concat([treatment.rename('treat'), age.rename('age'), stage_dummies], axis=1).astype(float)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    results.append({'module':mod, 'n_genes':len(modules[mod]),
                    'coef':model.params['treat'], 't':model.tvalues['treat'], 'p':model.pvalues['treat']})
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results).set_index('module')
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['p'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
print(res_df.sort_values('FDR'))

# 9. Pathway enrichment
sig_mods = res_df[res_df['FDR']<0.05].index.tolist()
if sig_mods:
    for m in sig_mods:
        genes = modules[m]
        enr = gp.enrichr(gene_list=genes, gene_sets=['KEGG_2019_Human'], outdir=None, verbose=False)
        df = enr.results
        drug_df = df[df['Term'].str.contains('Drug metabolism|ABC transporters|Glutathione metabolism', case=False)]
        print(f"Module {m} drug metabolism enrichment:")
        if drug_df.empty:
            print("  None")
        else:
            print(drug_df[['Term','Overlap','Adjusted P-value']])
            drug_df.set_index('Term')['Adjusted P-value'].sort_values().plot.barh(); plt.xlabel('Adj P-value'); plt.show()
else:
    print("No modules significant (FDR<0.05). Skipping enrichment.")

# 10. Module-trait heatmap
traits = pd.concat([treatment.rename('treat'), age.rename('age'), stage_dummies], axis=1).astype(float)
corrs = pd.DataFrame(index=traits.columns, columns=MEf.columns, dtype=float)
pvals = corrs.copy()
for tr in traits.columns:
    for m in MEf.columns:
        cor = np.corrcoef(MEf[m], traits[tr])[0,1]
        fit = sm.OLS(MEf[m], sm.add_constant(traits[tr])).fit()
        corrs.at[tr,m] = cor
        pvals.at[tr,m] = fit.pvalues[tr]
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.heatmap(corrs, annot=pvals.applymap(lambda v: f"p={v:.2g}"), cmap='vlag', center=0)
plt.title('Module-Trait Relationships'); plt.show()

# 11. Gene dendrogram with module colors
plt.figure(figsize=(12,4))
dendrogram(Z, no_labels=True, color_threshold=0)
colors = labels.map(lambda x: f'C{x%10}').loc[top_genes]
plt.scatter(range(len(colors)), [0]*len(colors), c=colors.values, marker='|', s=200)
plt.title('Gene dendrogram & module colors'); plt.show()

from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')

expr.columns = [col[:12] for col in expr.columns]

# 2. Define treatment groups
clin_sub = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'pharmaceutical_therapy']].dropna()
clin_sub = clin_sub[clin_sub['pharmaceutical_therapy'].isin(['YES','NO'])]
clin_sub = clin_sub.set_index('bcr_patient_barcode')
samples = expr.columns.intersection(clin_sub.index)
expr = expr[samples]
clin_sub = clin_sub.loc[samples]

treated = clin_sub[clin_sub['pharmaceutical_therapy']=='YES'].index.tolist()
untreated = clin_sub[clin_sub['pharmaceutical_therapy']=='NO'].index.tolist()
print(f"Samples: {len(treated)} treated, {len(untreated)} untreated")

# 3. Filter to top 5000 most variable genes
var = expr.var(axis=1)
top_genes = var.nlargest(5000).index
expr_var = expr.loc[top_genes]
print(f"Selected top {expr_var.shape[0]} variable genes.")

# 4. Build distance and cluster genes
print("Computing gene–gene distances and clustering...")
# Genes × samples matrix
data = expr_var.values
# Correlation matrix (genes × genes)
corr = np.corrcoef(data)
# Distance: 1 - |correlation|
dist = 1 - np.abs(corr)
# Condensed distance for clustering
dist_cond = squareform(dist, checks=False)
# Hierarchical clustering (average linkage)
Z = linkage(dist_cond, method='average')
# Cut into modules (e.g., 20 modules)
cluster_labels = fcluster(Z, t=20, criterion='maxclust')

# Module definitions
gene_modules = {}
for gene, lbl in zip(expr_var.index, cluster_labels):
    gene_modules.setdefault(lbl, []).append(gene)
# Keep modules with at least 10 genes
modules = {lbl: genes for lbl, genes in gene_modules.items() if len(genes) >= 10}
print(f"Identified {len(modules)} modules (>=10 genes each). ")

# 5. Compute module eigengenes
print("Calculating module eigengenes...")
eigengenes = {}
for lbl, genes in modules.items():
    # samples × genes
    mat = expr_var.loc[genes].T.values
    pca = PCA(n_components=1)
    eig = pca.fit_transform(mat).flatten()
    eigengenes[lbl] = pd.Series(eig, index=expr_var.columns)

print("Testing module-treatment associations...")
results = []

    grp_t = eig.loc[treated]
    grp_u = eig.loc[untreated]
    tstat, pval = ttest_ind(grp_t, grp_u, nan_policy='omit')
    effect = grp_t.mean() - grp_u.mean()
    results.append({'module': lbl, 'n_genes': len(modules[lbl]),

print(res_df.sort_values('fdr'))

        print("Performing pathway enrichment on significant modules...")
        for lbl in sig_mods:

            enr = gp.enrichr(gene_list=genes,

            else:

var = expr.var(axis=1)
top_genes = var.nlargest(5000).index

print("Selected top 5000 most variable genes.")

# Step 4: Soft-threshold power selection
print("Selecting soft-threshold power...")
corr = data.T.corr().values  # gene-gene correlation
powers = list(range(1, 21))
fit_indices = []
mean_connectivities = []
for p in powers:
    adj = np.abs(corr)**p
    # connectivity
    k = adj.sum(axis=1) - 1
    mean_connectivities.append(k.mean())
    # scale-free fit
    # bin degrees
    counts, bins = np.histogram(k, bins=10)
    mids = (bins[:-1] + bins[1:]) / 2
    mask = (counts > 0) & (mids > 0)
    if mask.sum() < 2:
        fit_indices.append(np.nan)
    else:
        x = np.log10(mids[mask])
        y = np.log10(counts[mask])
        coef = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
        y_pred = np.polyval(coef, x)
        # R^2
        ss_res = np.sum((y - y_pred)**2)
        ss_tot = np.sum((y - y.mean())**2)
        fit_indices.append(1 - ss_res/ss_tot)
# Plot fit index and mean connectivity

ax1.plot(powers, fit_indices, '-o', color='b')
ax1.axhline(0.85, color='b', linestyle='--')
ax1.set_xlabel('Soft-threshold power')
ax1.set_ylabel('Scale-free fit index', color='b')
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(powers, mean_connectivities, '-o', color='r')
ax2.set_ylabel('Mean connectivity', color='r')

    n = adj.shape[0]
    ki = adj.sum(axis=1)
    # numerator: adjacency + shared neighbors
    tom = np.zeros_like(adj)
    for i in range(n):
        tom[i] = (adj[i] * adj).sum(axis=1) + adj[i]
    ki = ki.reshape(-1,1)
    min_ki = np.minimum(ki, ki.T)
    tom = tom / (min_ki + 1 - adj)
